blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: FCI experiences severe financial strain due to a high food subsidy burden.
Storage losses and wastage represent major vulnerabilities in food grain management.
An inefficient supply chain hinders smooth and timely grain distribution.
Procurement operations suffer from significant regional imbalance.
Rising operational costs continuously increase the overall expenditure.
Competitive exam questions often highlight the financial issues of FCI, specifically the high food subsidy burden and rising operational costs.
Be prepared to identify core operational bottlenecks such as storage wastage, supply chain inefficiencies, and regional procurement imbalance.
